name: Endometrial Cancer Module
remarks: Simulates endometrial cancer development, diagnosis, treatment, and surveillance.
Includes risk factors, staging, treatment pathways, and recurrence monitoring.
Models both early-stage and advanced disease with appropriate interventions.
2026-08 remediation: the pre-fix module opened only 3 real Encounters
(PrimaryCareEvaluation, FollowUpVisit, PalliativeCareOnly) against 25
EncounterEnd states -- most of the diagnosis-to-treatment cascade had
no coherent encounter model at all: EndometrialCancerDiagnosis and
everything downstream of it (staging surgery, every risk-tier's
therapy, systemic therapy, response evaluation, second-line/salvage
therapy, recurrence surveillance) was reachable both with
PrimaryCareEvaluation's ambulatory encounter still open (a single
office visit silently absorbing major surgery, radiation, and chemo
over what the record shows as zero elapsed time) and, via the
hyperplasia-progression path, with nothing open at all -- and every
one of those 25 EncounterEnds fired with different context depending
on which path led there. This version closes PrimaryCareEvaluation
explicitly right after the diagnostic biopsy, so every downstream
cluster (staging surgery, each risk tier's radiation/chemo/hormonal
therapy, second-line and salvage therapy, periodic surveillance
visits) opens and closes its own dedicated encounter -- the same
one-cluster-per-clinical-action model used throughout
ovarian_cancer.json and bladder_cancer.json.
Also fixed: a duplicate hysterectomy on the low-risk arm (the
staging surgery already performs the definitive hysterectomy+BSO;
the old 'SurgeryOnly' state gave low-risk patients a second one);
8 CPT-system procedure codes recoded to SNOMED with matching
hcpcs_code_map.json rows; a genuine SNOMED miscoding (446096008 is
'Perennial allergic rhinitis', not 'clinical trial participation',
and collided with allergic_rhinitis.json's correct use of that same
code -- see ClinicalTrial's remarks); LocalRecurrence recoded off
'Widespread metastatic malignant neoplastic disease' to the
correctly-scoped 'Recurrent tumour'; per-pass recurrence rate
corrected from 35%/pass to 0.9%/pass (~13% cumulative over 5
years); the two separate pembrolizumab order paths consolidated
into one administered state; and the module's 8 open-ended
'stackable' medication orders given administration:true (the 5 IV
chemo/immunotherapy drugs -- discrete administered doses need
neither a stacking guard nor a MedicationEnd) or chronic:true plus
an attribute guard and, for the one genuinely fixed-course drug
(progesterone for hyperplasia), an explicit MedicationEnd.
cancer_stage attribute name (endometrial_cancer_stage) is
unchanged from the pre-fix module -- kept stable per task 5.4.

Lifetime endometrial cancer risk is about 3% in women. The Guard already selects women 50+ with risk factors; this gate scales that pool down to a realistic share (measured 15.9% of women at 0.25, so 0.05 lands near 3%).
Rate is a first-pass estimate and needs clinical review.
Recoded from CPT 58100 (a CPT code, not SNOMED, sitting directly in
the codes array -- one of the module's 8 CPT-system procedures) to
SNOMED 386802000 'Endometrial biopsy', verified active via Ontoserver
2026-08-10. hcpcs_code_map.json already carries a 386802000 row
(HCPCS G9823), so no new export row was needed.
The pre-fix module left this ambulatory encounter open through the
entire diagnosis-to-treatment cascade. Depending on path, downstream
EncounterEnds either closed this still-open encounter well after
major surgery/radiation/chemo had already happened 'inside' one
office visit, or -- on the hyperplasia-then-progression path, where
ProgesteroneTherapy_Encounter_End had already closed it -- fired with
nothing open at all. Close explicitly here, right after the biopsy,
so EndometrialCancerDiagnosis is always reached in the same (closed)
context regardless of path, and every downstream cluster opens its
own encounter.
Re-biopsy at the end of the progestin course is the natural point
to end the fixed-course medication order -- previously never ended
at all (one of the module's 8 stackable open-ended med orders).
Recoded from CPT 58571 to SNOMED 116140006 'Total hysterectomy',
verified active via Ontoserver 2026-08-10. No bilateral salpingo-
oophorectomy implied -- that's reserved for the cancer-staging
surgery (SurgicalStaging, 414575003 below), a clinically distinct,
more extensive procedure. Reached from two paths: hyperplasia
managed surgically up front, or persistent hyperplasia after a
failed progestin course -- both are the same operation.
Genuine inpatient length of stay after hysterectomy, allowed to sit
inside an open inpatient encounter (matching ovarian_cancer.json's
Primary_Surgery_Stay idiom).
Dropped the inline ICD-10-CM C54.1 code (a bad-system entry -- ICD-10-
CM does not belong in a module's codes array). condition_code_map.json
already maps 93781006 -> C54.1, so the export-time ICD lookup is
unaffected; only the redundant/invalid inline code was removed.

codes.display: Laparoscopic total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy

remarks: Recoded from CPT 58570 to SNOMED 414575003, verified active via
Ontoserver 2026-08-10. This is the definitive surgery: total
hysterectomy + BSO + staging. The pre-fix module additionally gave
the low-risk (Stage IA) arm its own separate 'SurgeryOnly' hysterectomy
(SNOMED 116144002) later in the pathway -- a second, duplicate
hysterectomy on the same patient. That state has been removed: this
surgery IS the surgery-only management for low-risk disease: once
pathology confirms Stage IA, nothing further is needed.
Genuine inpatient length of stay after staging surgery, allowed to
sit inside an open inpatient encounter.
Closes SurgicalStaging_Encounter. Low-risk (Stage IA) disease is
surgery-only -- the staging surgery above already was the definitive
treatment, so surveillance starts directly (no second hysterectomy).
Recoded from CPT 77776 to SNOMED 384692006, verified active via
Ontoserver 2026-08-10. Vaginal cuff brachytherapy for endometrial
cancer is delivered via an intracavitary vaginal cylinder applicator,
not the interstitial technique CPT 77776 actually describes -- no
pre-coordinated 'vaginal cuff brachytherapy' SNOMED concept exists
(searched; only applicator-device concepts like 464859007 do), so
the general active intracavitary-brachytherapy concept is used.
Recoded from CPT 77427 to SNOMED 33195004, verified active via
Ontoserver 2026-08-10. Same SNOMED concept reused by
AdjuvantRadiationTherapy and RadiationSalvage below -- all three are
the same real-world external-beam radiation-management encounter.
Administered IV chemo (carboplatin + paclitaxel), not a standing
prescription -- was an open-ended MedicationOrder with no
administration flag, chronic flag, duration, or End (one of the 8
stackable open-ended med orders). Both RxCUIs already map to
HCPCS J-codes in rxnorm_hcpcs_map.json (J9045/J9267).

remarks: Reachable both from first-line SystemicTherapy and again from
SystemicTherapy after a later DistantRecurrence -- without this
guard a patient already on chronic megestrol could be given a second,
simultaneously-active order for the same drug (one of the module's 8
stackable open-ended med orders). If already active, nothing new to
order -- go straight back into the evaluation loop.
Consolidates the pre-fix module's two separate pembrolizumab order
paths (first-line TargetedTherapy and second-line Immunotherapy --
same RxCUI, same drug) into one administered state shared by both
SystemicTherapy and SecondLineTherapy. RxNorm 1657750 already maps
to HCPCS J9271 in rxnorm_hcpcs_map.json.
Same stacking hazard and same fix as HormonalTherapy_Guard above --
shares the hormonal_therapy_active attribute with it (it's the same
drug), so a patient already on megestrol from the first-line arm is
not given a second simultaneous order here.
The pre-fix code, 446096008, is not a clinical-trial concept at all --
verified via Ontoserver 2026-08-10 that it actually means 'Perennial
allergic rhinitis' (and is used with that meaning, correctly, by
allergic_rhinitis.json). A patient with both allergic rhinitis and
this second-line arm would have collided on the same code across a
Condition and a Procedure -- the same HealthRecord.present
ClassCastException class of record-dropping bug documented in
task-1.10-report.md's 103735009 writeup. Recoded to 709491003
'Enrolment in clinical trial', verified active and otherwise unused
in this tree.
Recoded from CPT 58960 to SNOMED 238302003, verified active via
Ontoserver 2026-08-10.
Genuine inpatient length of stay after cytoreductive/debulking
surgery, allowed to sit inside an open inpatient encounter.
The pre-fix module rolled recurrence status (RecurrenceCheck) and
closed with SurveillanceAdvanced_Encounter_End / NoEvidenceDisease
_Encounter_End without ever opening an encounter for this
periodic surveillance visit -- both were orphan EncounterEnds.
Per-pass recurrence rate corrected from 35% (0.20 local + 0.15
distant) to 0.9% per ~4-month pass -- compounded over roughly 15
passes across 5 years, (1-0.009)^15 = 0.87, i.e. ~13% cumulative
5-year recurrence, matching published endometrial cancer recurrence
rates (about 13% overall recur within 5 years across stages/risk
groups). The pre-fix 35%-per-pass rate implied virtually every
surveilled patient would recur almost immediately.
Was SNOMED 405843009 'Widespread metastatic malignant neoplastic
disease' -- coding a LOCAL recurrence as widespread metastatic
disease is backwards (that's a worse, systemic-disease concept, and
duplicates what DistantRecurrence already correctly represents).
SNOMED has no pre-coordinated 'local recurrence of malignant
neoplasm of endometrium/vagina' concept (the 'Local recurrence of
malignant neoplasm of X' family covers breast/lung/colon/etc. but
not the endometrium or vagina -- searched via Ontoserver 2026-08-10).
25173007 'Recurrent tumour' is the closest active, correctly-scoped
general concept; the module context (target_encounter, the
surrounding Surveillance_Visit) supplies the site.
